content: NubsCarson: Drove significant enhancements to the elizaos/eliza ecosystem by merging 11 pull requests that introduced key features like the Discord /ask command (#16067) and Cartesia Sonic voice TTS (#16030), while simultaneously stabilizing core agent behavior through critical fixes for model drift, redirect chains, and authentication race conditions. Their work was heavily focused on bugfix efforts, with 77% of their 62 commits dedicated to resolving stability issues and refining agent performance across 289 modified files.
